proposals.note: Click a label to select it; the rulers highlight it. Clicking empty canvas clears the selection. Drag with Space held or with the middle button to pan; Ctrl + wheel zooms.

print.note: The pink cut line and crop marks appear only in print preview. Pages outside the visible area are not drawn; they are drawn as you pan.
